scripts.text: You handled this troublesome intruders very well. It gave me an impression that, you're a very skilled adventurer who handles this kind of situation splendidly.
scripts.translation: 謝。您妥善處理了這些棘手的入侵者，讓我印象深刻。您是一位很有本領、能出色應對這類情況的冒險者。

scripts.text: You quickly learned the geography of the mansion, and you quickly become accustomed with the automatic dolls. It was impressive.
scripts.translation: 您很快就熟悉了宅邸的佈局，也很快適應了自動人偶，真令人佩服。

scripts.text: Please take a look around the mansion and if you ever find any problems, I would like to ask for your help.
scripts.translation: 請繼續參觀宅邸。如果發現任何問題，希望您能幫忙處理。

scripts.text: We automatic dolls serve the human guests as how we served the owner of the mansion, we are already familiar with it. But we have insufficient information and response skills to unfamiliar problems.
scripts.translation: 我們自動人偶服務人類賓客的方式，與服務宅邸主人時相同，這方面已經很熟練了。但遇到陌生的問題時，我們掌握的資訊和應對能力都不足。

scripts.text: We still haven't resolved the problem with the intruders. From a non-human perspective, it seems difficult to resolve it because there are many parts that doesn't have enough information.
scripts.translation: 入侵者造成的問題還沒有解決。從非人類的角度來看，許多情況缺乏足夠的資訊，處理起來很困難。

scripts.text: We would like to collect resolving intruder problems related data through {0}, It will be a great help in future cases.
scripts.translation: 我們想通過收集處理入侵者問題的資料，以便應對今後的類似事件。 {0}

scripts.text: It's not much, but as a token of appreciation, I will give you this.
scripts.translation: 這只是小小心意，請收下。這是

You can freely eat anything with it, feel free to use it anytime.

scripts.text: The mansion's <NAVI>[restaurant]<INFO>ba_maison,146,109,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is located at the bottom, as I showed earlier.
scripts.translation: 宅邸的<NAVI>[餐廳]<INFO>ba_maison,146,109,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>就在下層，位置和我剛才指的一樣。

scripts.text: Those who came before you are now staying at the <NAVI>[tea house]<INFO>ba_in01,206,106,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, please take a look around and talk with them.

scripts.text: If you have any inconvenience in the mansion, please feel free to tell any automatic dolls. Please take this Barmeal Ticket, as a token of appreciation for your hard work.
scripts.translation: 如果在宅邸裡遇到不便，請隨時告訴任一自動人偶。也請收下這張餐券，感謝您的辛勞。

scripts.text: Those who came before you are now staying at the <NAVI>[tea house]<INFO>ba_in01,206,106,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, please take a look around and talk with them.
scripts.translation: 比您先到的同伴目前住在<NAVI>[茶室]<INFO>ba_in01,206,106,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。請去看看並和他們聊聊。

scripts.text: Do you have something you need or are you uncomfortable in any ways?
scripts.translation: 在宅邸裡遇到不便，或有什麼需要，請儘管告

scripts.text: Oh, by any chance did you come to bring me a spare communication chips for the repeater?
scripts.translation: 訴自動人偶。哦，您是來送中繼器備用通訊晶片的嗎？

scripts.text: The supply of the repeater's communication chips is sufficient.
scripts.translation: 中繼器的通訊晶片儲備充足。暫時不用擔心

scripts.text: Don't worry about the repeater. Please rest for today and come back ^0000CDafter dawn^000000.
Are you here today to help me get spare communication chips for the repeater?
scripts.translation: 您今天是來幫忙收集中繼器備用通訊晶片的嗎？

scripts.text: In that case, did you come here because of any inconvenience while using the mansion facilities?
scripts.translation: 那麼，您是使用宅邸設施時遇到了不便嗎？告訴

scripts.text: If you tell the nearest automatic doll, we'll take care of it right away.
scripts.translation: 最近的自動人偶，我們會立刻處理。

scripts.text: Thank you so much for your help today.
scripts.translation: 非常感謝您今天的幫助。

scripts.text: Please bring me ^0000CD10 Automatic Doll Communication Chips^000000 for the repeater. I think that will be enough for the days supply.
scripts.translation: 請給我10個自動人偶通訊晶片，供中繼器使用。我想這些夠用幾天了。 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: It also help us with the broken automatic dolls roaming around the mansion. Please take care of any Broken Betas roaming around the mansion and bring it's communication chips with you.
scripts.translation: 這些晶片也能幫助我們處理在宅邸裡遊蕩的故障自動人偶。請擊退遊蕩的故障貝塔，並帶回它們的通訊晶片。
那麼就拜託您了，冒險者。

scripts.translation: 有什麼需要，或者覺得哪裡不方便嗎？

scripts.text: Are you here for that matter? Thank you very much for your concern.
scripts.translation: 您是為這件事來的？非常感謝您的關心。

scripts.text: Just like the previous situation, the network status in some area of the mansion are losing connectivity.
scripts.translation: 和上次一樣，宅邸部分割槽域的網路連線又中斷了。

scripts.text: Although it's repaired upon discovery, it's a problem that occurs continuously. The necessary communication chips demand are difficult to supply.
scripts.translation: 雖然發現後都會立即修復，但故障不斷發生，所需通訊晶片也很難補足。

scripts.text: In addition, the broken automatic dolls is wandering around and keeps destroying the repeaters, doubling the supply needed.
scripts.translation: 此外，故障自動人偶四處遊蕩，不斷破壞中繼器，所需晶片數量因此翻倍。

scripts.text: Thank you for considering the difficulties. We will take care of the repeater as soon as possible so that there will be no inconvenience when using it.
scripts.translation: 感謝您體諒我們的難處。我們會盡快修好中繼器，確保使用設施時不受影響。

scripts.text: Thank you very much. But I'm afraid that I'm taking too much of your time {0}... If you don't mind at all, I'd like to ask you a favor.
scripts.translation: 非常感謝。不過我擔心佔用了您太多時間，......如果您不介意，我還想請您幫個忙。 {0}

scripts.translation: 您帶來我拜託您收集的自動人偶通訊晶片了嗎？

scripts.text: This is enough for the day. Thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation: 今天的用量夠了。辛苦您了。如果有時

scripts.text: If you have time, I'd like to ask for your help again ^0000CDafter dawn^000000, If you don't mind please come again tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 間，天亮後還想再請您幫忙。方便的話，明天再來吧。 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: Thank you very much. Please take this with you.
The number of items in your possession is too high, so you cannot proceed with the conversation.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品太多，無法繼續交談。請

scripts.text: Please clean up your inventory and try again.
Ugh! Now, wait. What is that? Tch, the intruder?
scripts.translation: 呃！等等，那是什麼？嘖，是入侵者嗎？

scripts.text: That's right! That's right! Oh, what should I do? What do I do, What do I do? Security? Oh, yeah. I was told to call security.
scripts.translation: 沒錯！就是入侵者！怎麼辦？我該怎麼辦？保安？對了，有人叫我去找保安！

scripts.text: What? It's not working! When did it break down? Oh, what do I do?
scripts.translation: 什麼？怎麼不管用！什麼時候壞掉的？我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text: Yeah! Mochi! I'll give you a piece of Mochi, so why don't we go somewhere else? You like mochi, don't you?
scripts.translation: 對了！麻糬！我給你一塊麻糬，我們換個地方好不好？你喜歡麻糬吧？

scripts.text: Oh, it's not mochi? Aren't you the guy I met before? Then, meat? Do you like meat? You like meat, don't you? I've never seen anyone who doesn't like meat. I'll give you all the meat I have.
scripts.translation: 咦，不是麻糬？你不是我之前遇到的那個人嗎？那肉呢？你喜歡肉吧？我還沒見過不喜歡肉的人呢。我把身上的肉全給你。

scripts.text: Strange? It's not meat? Then what can I get you? Do you want to go back?
scripts.translation: 奇怪，不是肉？那我還能給你什麼？你想回去嗎？

scripts.text: Oh, what should I do? I was told not to run to the intruders. Are you here to ^0000CDtake my parts^000000? Is this the end of me?
scripts.translation: 怎麼辦？有人叫我別靠近入侵者。你是來拆我的零件的嗎？我就要完蛋了嗎？ ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: I'm not that kind of person.
You're not that kind of person...? Then, what kind of person are you?
scripts.translation: 你不是那種人......？那你是哪種人？

scripts.text: Hold on...? You're right? You're not drooling, and your eyes are normal. Are you not an ^0000CDintruder^000000?
scripts.translation: 等等......你說得對。你沒流口水，眼神也很正常。你不是入侵者嗎？ ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: I'm a guest of the mansion, but...
What? A guest? Oh wait. I'll check...
scripts.translation: 什麼？客人？等等，我查檢視......

scripts.text: It's real? But... You're a first time guest? New guest? Finally? Oh, I'm sorry for mistaking you as an intruder.
scripts.translation: 真的？不過......你是第一次來的新客人？終於有新客人了？哎呀，抱歉把你錯認成入侵者。

scripts.text: I thought you were one of the intruder.
scripts.translation: 我還以為你是入侵者之一

scripts.text: Somehow, everyone said they were running away, it's because of you, the new guests, right?
scripts.translation: 。大家不知為何都說他們在逃跑，是因為你這個新客人嗎？

scripts.text: What's your relationship with the intruder? Are we natural enemies? Which way is above the pyramid? The intruders is running away, so it's your fault?
scripts.translation: 你和入侵者是什麼關係？我們是天敵嗎？金字塔的上面是哪邊？入侵者在逃跑，所以是你的錯嗎？

scripts.text: Oh, really? I didn't know because it's been so long since I saw a human being.
scripts.translation: 真的嗎？我很久沒見過人類了，難怪不知道。可是

scripts.text: So why didn't I recognize a guest? All new guests would have been shared to us.
scripts.translation: 新客人的資訊都會同步給我們，我怎麼沒認出你呢？

scripts.text: Oh, no wonder! The network stopped working suddenly. The repeater is not functioning! Then why isn't Alpha coming?
scripts.translation: 難怪！網路突然斷了，原來是中繼器故障！那阿爾法怎麼還沒來？

scripts.text: Alpha is too busy to come? No way. Oh, were you trying to help me voluntarily? What an unusual guest. Come to think of it, there was a^0000CDcustomer like that before^000000.
scripts.translation: 阿爾法忙得來不了？怎麼會。哦，你是自願來幫我的？真是少見的客人。說起來，以前也有過這樣的客人。 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: The guest who visited the mansion showed interest in the mansion and us automatic dolls, but there were no guests who helped us around the mansion.
scripts.translation: 以前來宅邸的客人雖然對宅邸和我們自動人偶很感興趣，卻沒人幫忙處理宅邸裡的事。

scripts.text: Anyway, If we have a lot of guests, they'll be coming to eat soon. I've got to prepare. It's been a long time since I've had guests.
scripts.translation: 總之來了這麼多客人，他們很快就會來吃飯。我得去準備了，好久沒招待客人了。

scripts.text: I haven't had any guests in the restaurant for a long time. I had no customer when I was cooking. The intruders... when they got here. My eyes change and I took them away. They were not guests.
scripts.translation: 餐廳已經很久沒有客人了。以前我做飯時總是沒有顧客。入侵者......他們一闖進來，我的眼睛就變了，於是把他們帶走了。他們不是客人。

scripts.text: The invaders didn't last long, but they threw the mansion into chaos in that brief moment. They took the machines in the mansion, the automatic dools, everything that seemed useful to them were removed out of place.
scripts.translation: 入侵者沒待多久，卻在短短時間裡把宅邸攪得一團亂。他們把機器、自動人偶，還有所有看起來有用的東西都拆走了。

scripts.text: That repeater over there must have a ^0000CDbroken communication chip too^000000?
scripts.translation: 那邊的中繼器通訊晶片也壞掉了嗎？ ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: Damn humans. Most of them seems to have run away by now, but there are still some left. I've seen them here a few times. They're after the food.
scripts.translation: 可惡的人類。大多數好像已經逃走了，不過還剩一些。我見過他們幾次，他們是衝著食物來的。

scripts.text: Now that I see it, I don't know why I mistaken you as an intruder. You're different.
scripts.translation: 現在看清楚了，我也不明白剛才為什麼把你當成入侵者。你和他們不一樣。

scripts.text: Anyway, I have to fix the repeater. Let me see...
scripts.translation: 總之，我得修好中繼器。讓我看看......

scripts.text: Well... the communication chip was ripped off! I'll have to put it in. Where should we get it right now? I have to greet guests?
scripts.translation: 糟了，通訊晶片被扯掉了！得裝一塊新的。現在該去哪裡找呢？可是我還得招待客人！

scripts.text: Ugh- There's another broken one over there.
scripts.translation: 唉......那邊還有一個壞掉的。

scripts.text: {0}. Can you catch that? Can you do it?
Uh. All communication chips are standard, so if they're replaced with a new one. I think it'll return back to normal.
scripts.translation: 嗯，所有通訊晶片都是通用規格。換上一塊新的，我想它就能恢復正常。

scripts.text: Why do you look like that? Is it because you're reluctant to hurt an automatic doll in front of another one? Don't worry about that.
scripts.translation: 你怎麼這副表情？是不想當著另一臺自動人偶的面傷害它嗎？別擔心。

scripts.text: We need to repair it anyway, but we need to capture it first.
scripts.translation: 反正我們也得修好它，只是得先抓住它

scripts.text: You can think of it as saving the trouble for us automatic dolls.
scripts.translation: 。就當是在幫我們自動人偶省點力氣吧。

scripts.text: If you leave it alone, it will wander around the mansion and destroy it, so you'll have to deal with it quickly as you can.
scripts.translation: 放任不管的話，它會在宅邸裡亂跑並破壞東西，所以得儘快處理。

scripts.text: It's better to capture it, then take out the chip and use it to fix the repeater.
scripts.translation: 最好先抓住它，再取出晶片修好中繼器。

scripts.text: Everyone has been doing that ever since the intruders showed up. Even if {0} doesn't do it, it's all up to us automatic dolls.
scripts.translation: 入侵者來之後，我們一直在處理這些事。就算不幫忙，也只能靠我們自動人偶自己來 {0}

scripts.text: It's nice to work a little bit.
Please take care of the Broken Beta and bring ^0000CD1 Automatic Doll Communication Chip^000000.
scripts.translation: 請處理故障貝塔，並帶回1個自動人偶通訊晶片。 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: You haven't yet? Are you reluctant to hurt an automatic doll? Don't worry about it. I will do it later on anyway.
scripts.translation: 還沒找到嗎？是不忍心傷害自動人偶嗎？別擔心，反正我之後也會處理。

scripts.text: I'll take care of the broken automatic dolls, just bring ^0000CD1 Automatic Doll Communication Chip^000000.
scripts.translation: 故障自動人偶交給我處理，你只要帶回1個自動人偶通訊晶片就行。 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: Did you bring it? Give it to me. I'll fix it. Thank you very much for bringing it.
scripts.translation: 帶回來了嗎？交給我吧，我來修。非常感謝你把它帶回來。

scripts.text: By the way, is that the only broken repeater?
scripts.translation: 對了，壞掉的中繼器只有這一個嗎？

scripts.text: Oh, really? Then go ahead to the <NAVI>[pavilion]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI> first. It's the closest one here. Just follow this road over here.
scripts.translation: 這樣啊，那先去<NAVI>[涼亭]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>吧，那裡最近。沿著這條路走就行。

scripts.text: Don't touch the broken repeater carelessly. Tell the nearby automatic dolls over there and they'll take care of it.
scripts.translation: 別隨便碰壞掉的中繼器。告訴附近的自動人偶，它們會處理的。

scripts.text: Do you happen to have a Barmeal Ticket? It's use to eat at the restaurant. I'll give you this, so come and eat later! I'll prepare a good food for you! As thanks!
scripts.translation: 你有餐券嗎？可以在餐廳用。我把這張給你，之後來吃飯吧！我會準備好吃的，感謝你幫忙！

scripts.text: Go ahead to the <NAVI>[pavilion]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI> first. It's the closest one here. Just follow this road over here.
scripts.translation: 先去<NAVI>[涼亭]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>吧，那裡最近。沿著這條路走就行。

scripts.text: Don't touch the broken repeater carelessly. Tell the nearby automatic dolls over there and they'll take care of it.
scripts.translation: 別隨便碰壞掉的中繼器。告訴附近的自動人偶，它們會處理的。

scripts.text: What should I make today... What should I do to make it taste good?
scripts.translation: 今天做什麼好呢......怎樣才能做得更好吃呢？

scripts.text: You cannot receive any more items because you're carrying too many items. Please try again after you lighten up.^000000
scripts.translation: 0等一下！！你帶的東西太多，無法再領取物品。減輕負重後再試。 ^000000

scripts.text: There's no one here...? What should I do with this? Is the automatic doll communication chip broken again...?
scripts.translation: 這裡沒人......這東西該怎麼辦？自動人偶的通訊晶片又壞了嗎......？

scripts.text: This...! What a mess! Here we go again! It wants to fight.
scripts.translation: 這......真是一團糟！又來了！它又想打架。

scripts.text: Get out of my head right now!
scripts.translation: 立刻從我腦子裡滾出去！

scripts.text: Are you trying to control me?
This little thing! I'll dispose of it!
scripts.translation: 這小東西！我這就把它處理掉！

scripts.text: Are you trying to take over me?? Just try!!
scripts.translation: 你想佔據我的身體？！儘管試試！！

scripts.text: What should I do? Should I just go?
scripts.translation: 我該怎麼辦？就這麼走嗎？

scripts.text: Phew- Here you are. Why do you keep escaping? Calm down for a bit.
scripts.translation: 呼——你來了。你怎麼老是逃跑？先冷靜一下。

scripts.text: Anyway, who...? An intruder? ...Is it not?
scripts.translation: 對了，你是誰......？是入侵者嗎？......好像不是？

scripts.text: Oh, you're a guest, aren't you? Those who come and go in front of the pavilion are also guests.
scripts.translation: 哦，你是客人吧？在涼亭前來來往往的那些人也都是客人。

scripts.text: But that's weird. If you're a guest, I would recognize you in an instance.
scripts.translation: 不過有點奇怪。客人的話，我應該一眼就認出來才對。

scripts.text: You are not an unregistered guest, you're a regular guest here.
scripts.translation: 你不是沒登記的陌生客人，而是這裡的常客呢。

scripts.text: They can't share it because of the repeater.
scripts.translation: 因為中繼器壞了，名單沒法同步。

scripts.text: Oh, it's because of that! Everytime time I find something broken, I'll repair it, but as you can see, even if I take my eyes out for a moment, Wary comes out and break it like this.

scripts.translation: 我還興致勃勃地給他們講鍋爐知識，沒想到他們居然會偷走鍋爐。我......真的沒想到。人類都這麼隨心所欲嗎？

scripts.text: For example. My master says that it's cool when he soaked in the bath, but when I soaked myself. It's incredibly hot. Did I set the temperature wrong? I did, but it wasn't for him.
scripts.translation: 比如，主人說泡澡很涼爽，可我自己泡時卻覺得燙得受不了。是溫度設錯了嗎？確實是我調的，不過那是按主人的要求設定的。

scripts.text: But it's cool. What does that mean? Am I mistaken?
scripts.translation: 他說涼爽是什麼意思？是我弄錯了嗎？

scripts.text: And then. If you soak these dry leaves in hot water, the contents of the leaves comes out. But it's just that.
scripts.translation: 還有，把幹葉子泡在熱水裡，葉子的成分就會出來，僅此而已。

scripts.text: But somehow it's good for your health, that's why we fill every bath with herbal leaves. Do humans breath on their skins? Or do you drink water from your skins?
scripts.translation: 可聽說這對健康有益，所以每個浴池都放了草藥葉。人類會用皮膚呼吸嗎？還是用皮膚喝水？

scripts.text: Humans are happy to immerse themselves in the bath. Why is that?
scripts.translation: 人類為什麼喜歡把身體泡在浴池裡呢？

scripts.text: Oh, there's another one! Why do you put ground seaweed in the bath and apply the water on your face?
scripts.translation: 哦，還有！為什麼要把磨碎的海藻放進浴池，再把水敷在臉上？

scripts.text: I was so curious that I tried it myself, but I didn't know what it was good for. Maybe because I'm an automatic doll?
scripts.translation: 我很好奇，就自己試了試，可不知道有什麼用。難道是因為我是自動人偶？

scripts.text: If I had five senses like humans, I could have understand humans better. Why didn't the master gave us that?
scripts.translation: 如果我也有和人類一樣的五感，就能更理解人類了。主人為什麼沒給我們這些能力呢？

scripts.text: It's all done. You have to drink now.
scripts.translation: 都準備好了，現在該喝了。

scripts.text: I'm not going to drink. No one's drinking.
Is not ready yet? Can't you just drink a little? Squeeze it out and you'll get a lot of essence.
scripts.translation: 還沒好嗎？不能先喝一點嗎？擠一擠就能擠出很多精華。

scripts.text: Valve. Humans are not tea bags. Remember, I've said this many times.
scripts.translation: 閥門，人類不是茶包。我已經說過很多次了。

scripts.text: All you have to do is boil the water well.
The temperature needs to be increased to make it better.
I told you not to touch the boiler.
Stop it and come over here.
It's okay because it's quiet for a while.
scripts.translation: 暫時安靜下來了，應該沒事。

scripts.text: It looks dangerous, but the disposal...
scripts.translation: 看起來很危險，不過......要把它報廢嗎？

scripts.text: Why waste it! It'll still be useful if we fix it. Who am I supposed to work with if you scrap Valve? I don't like strangers.
scripts.translation: 為什麼要報廢！修好後還能用。要是你把閥門拆掉，我和誰一起工作？我不喜歡陌生人。

scripts.text: Because I can't leave my hands off the boiler? The intruders broke the boiler and the valves, and there was no time to fix them.
scripts.translation: 因為我得一直看著鍋爐啊！入侵者弄壞了鍋爐和閥門，當時根本沒時間修。

scripts.text: I'm alone and the boiler room has to be ran by two, but I'm the only one left. There's no time to fix it. I can send it somewhere else, I'm worried that they'll reformat the data.
scripts.translation: 鍋爐房原本要兩個人一起運作，現在只剩我一個，根本抽不出時間修。送去別處修的話，我又怕他們把資料重置

scripts.text: It's not so serious, I can fix it slowly. Valve is not that bad, it only touches the boiler sometimes. I don't know much about humans, but I know a lot about herbs and boilers.
scripts.translation: 。情況也沒那麼糟，我可以慢慢修。閥門還好，只是偶爾會碰到鍋爐。我不太懂人類，但很懂藥草和鍋爐。

scripts.text: But I still have to fix it.
If you're free, please help me. I'm short on hands. The valve and the boiler needs to be fixed. But I'm alone and the other dolls are busy.
scripts.translation: 有空的話請幫幫我，人手不夠。鍋爐和閥門都要修，但我一個人忙不過來，其他人偶也

scripts.translation: 都很忙。真希望我能有兩個自己！那樣這裡就是最棒的鍋爐房了。

scripts.text: I'll ask Alpha to clone me. I don't know if it's possible, but logically, it's more efficient if there's two of me.
scripts.translation: 我會請阿爾法克隆一個我。不知道能不能做到，但按理說兩個我效率更高。

scripts.text: But, what can I do right now? There's no other me. I should ask for help. So please help me if you're free.
scripts.translation: 不過眼下沒有另一個我，只能找人幫忙。所以有空的話請幫幫我。

Really? Then there's nothing I can do. You also look tired, so I'll send you herbs for recovery. Goodbye.
scripts.translation: 這樣啊，那我也沒辦法。你看起來也累了，我給你些恢復用的藥草吧。再見。

scripts.text: Thank you. Then, can you handle 20 ^0000CDbroken automatic dolls^000000? I also need 5 ^0000CDbroken automatic doll parts^000000.

scripts.text: What brings you here today? Oh, is it for work?
scripts.translation: 今天來有什麼事？哦，是來幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I don't know why you are here. Nothing has changed here. We are still working on the boiler.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我也不知道你為什麼來。這裡沒什麼變化，我們還在忙著修理鍋爐。

scripts.text: Umm... I heard humans break down easily if they work too much. Please go get some rest and come back after dawn.
scripts.translation: 嗯......聽說人類工作太久會累壞。先去休息吧，天亮後再回來。

scripts.text: I'l like to take a break today.
That's weird. I thought you came to see me because you want to get work, right? Well, I understand.
scripts.translation: 真奇怪，我還以為你是來找活幹的。嗯，我明白了。

scripts.text: How can there be such a sincere human? Then, today too please handle 20 ^0000CDbroken automatic dolls^000000 and bring 5 ^0000CDbroken automatic doll parts^000000.
scripts.translation: 竟然有這麼熱心的人類！那今天也拜託你處理20個故障自動人偶，並帶回5個故障自動人偶零件。 ^0000CD^000000^0000CD^000000

You've brought a lot. Well, I'll trade it for this barmeal ticket. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 你帶來不少啊。好吧，我用這張餐券和你交換。謝謝。

What's going on? See you come all the way here, are you here to look at something at the boiler?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？你特地跑來這裡，是想看看鍋爐嗎？

scripts.text: The boiler is already stopped. Isn't that why you're here? Shouldn't you go and report?
scripts.translation: 鍋爐不是已經停了嗎？你是為這事來的吧？那該去報告了。

scripts.text: Is there anything left to see here? Didn't you have something to do?
scripts.translation: 這裡還有什麼可看的？你不是還有別的事要做嗎？

scripts.text: What's going on? Do we still have a story to hear? Haven't you found the all the answer for the monsters?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？還有什麼事要問嗎？關於魔物的答案不是都找到了嗎？

scripts.text: I'd like to talk to you.
What do you want to talk about? The only thing I can talk about is cleaning. Are you curious about cleaning?
scripts.translation: 想聊什麼？我只懂清潔。你對清潔感興趣嗎？公共浴場

scripts.text: Hygiene is very important here because it's a public bath. Besides cleaning regularly everyday, I do it as often as necessary.
scripts.translation: 的衛生非常重要。我們每天定期清潔，也會在有需要時隨時打掃。

scripts.text: Automatic dolls for cleaning sweeps foreign substances and dirt all over the place. This basic policy is to send all the guests out of the bathhouse when cleaning, but if the guest want to continue taking a bath, we shouldn't bother them and wait.
scripts.translation: 負責清潔的自動人偶會清除各處的異物和汙垢。通常清潔時會請客人離開浴場，但如果客人想繼續泡澡，我們就不能打擾，只能等他們結束。

scripts.text: However, it is not recommended that the automatic dolls that come out for cleaning should not be approached as much as possible because they are dangerous and they're for cleaning purposes only.
scripts.translation: 清潔時出現的自動人偶很危險，而且只負責打掃，所以最好不要靠近。其實清潔人偶以前沒

scripts.text: Actually, the cleaning dolls wasn't as strong as it is now. The measure was taken inevitably because of the intruders.
scripts.translation: 這麼強，是入侵者闖入後，我們才不得不採取這種措施。

scripts.text: Have you seen the intruder before? When I found them in the bath, my switch for intruder was activated, I didn't let them in. But they came by swarm and forced their way in.
scripts.translation: 你以前見過入侵者嗎？他們闖進浴場時，我的入侵者警報啟動了，所以沒有放他們進來。可他們成群強闖，硬是進去了。

scripts.text: They went through places where you can fit your body, such as water pipes and drains. The fish from the lake are also able to enter through the pipes.
scripts.translation: 他們鑽過能容納身體的地方，比如水管和排水溝。湖裡的魚也會從管道游進來。

scripts.text: Thanks to them, cleaning became more difficult. The intruder even interfered when I was cleaning. And they didn't even bother helping me clean after.
scripts.translation: 多虧他們，清潔難度增加了。入侵者甚至在我打掃時搗亂，事後也不幫忙收拾。

scripts.text: This is a bathhouse. Hygiene should be the top priority. The cleaner automatic dolls are strengthened because of that.
scripts.translation: 這裡是浴場，衛生應該擺在第一位。因此我們強化了清潔人偶。

scripts.text: The intruder took a step back however they're not completely gone yet. Therefore, the cleaner dolls had no choice but to remain the strengthened form. So be careful when coming into contact during cleaning time.
scripts.translation: 入侵者雖然暫時退走，卻還沒有徹底離開。所以清潔人偶不得不繼續保持強化狀態。清潔時遇到它們要小心。

scripts.text: I don't know what the humans want.
scripts.translation: 我不知道人類想要什麼

scripts.text: However, humans needs to take a bath and the space to do so. The task that was given to me was cleaning. It's all I know.
scripts.translation: 。不過人類需要洗澡，也需要洗澡的地方。我的工作就是清潔，我只知道這些。

scripts.text: There were two groups of intruders. One was obsessed with the bath and the other one is in it's facilites. What they had in common is that they're both obsessed with something.
scripts.translation: 入侵者分成兩撥。一撥痴迷於泡澡，另一撥則盯上這裡的設施。他們都有各自執著的目標。

scripts.text: Humans that are obsessed with bathing did not cooperate with the cleaning, and humans obsessed with the facilities destroyed the facilites and the automatic dolls managing it.
scripts.translation: 痴迷泡澡的那夥人不配合清潔，盯上設施的那夥人則破壞設施和管理設施的自動

scripts.text: The boiler was ripped apart and stolen, pipes were broken, and automatic dolls are dismantled. The other say they don't know how long will it take to recover from this. The situation in the other part of the mansion is not much different, the entire mansion is in this predicament.
scripts.translation: 人偶。鍋爐被拆走，管道被弄壞，人偶也被拆解。聽說修復需要很長時間。宅邸其他區域也差不多，整個宅邸都陷入困境。

scripts.text: What is the biggest feature that distinguish guests from the intruders? Why do guests and intruders have different behavior patterns? How do humans tell the difference between the two?
scripts.translation: 客人和入侵者最大的區別是什麼？為什麼他們的行為模式不同？人類又是怎麼分辨他們的？

scripts.text: We, the automatic dolls, think it's natural that we don't know because we've only been in contact with guests before.
scripts.translation: 我們自動人偶以前只接觸過客人，所以不知道這些也很正常。我們感受不

scripts.translation: 到人類能感受到的東西，甚至連指尖的觸感都感覺不到。

scripts.text: But even if I don't know such thing, It won't impose a problem on my work. I can clean. I can carry out the task that was given to me. What is designated as trash should be swept away.
scripts.translation: 不過，不瞭解這些並不影響我的工作。我能打掃，也能完成指派的任務。被認定為垃圾的東西就該掃走。

scripts.text: Human beings are human beings, automatic dolls are automatic dolls.
scripts.translation: 人類就是人類，自動人偶就是自動人偶。

scripts.text: But... I'd be happy if you could help me with one thing. Are you interested?
scripts.translation: 不過......你願意幫我一件事嗎？我會很高興的。

scripts.text: I see. I understand. I learned that I should not take the time of a busy guest.
scripts.translation: 我明白。忙碌的客人不該被打擾。

scripts.text: Then can I ask you to exterminate ^0000CD15 Boiling Piranha and 15 Boiling Marc^000000. They are one of the main cause of the miss in the bathhouse.
scripts.translation: 那麼，請幫我消滅15只沸騰食人魚和15只沸騰馬克。它們是浴場難以保持清潔的主要原因。 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: Other parts of the mansion are also lacking in hands, so we have to do it ourselves. I clean up whenever I can, but there are too many. It must not be delayed too much because it's about hygiene and safety. Then, please.
scripts.translation: 宅邸其他地方也人手不足，只能由我們自己處理。我儘可能隨時清掃，可數量實在太多。衛生和安全不能耽擱。拜託了。

scripts.text: What's the matter? Are you here to help me?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？你是來幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text: Cleaning is something I do usually. It's just difficult at the moment since there are too many obstacles.
scripts.translation: 清潔是我平時的工作。只是現在障礙太多，做起來比較困難。

scripts.text: Um.. I'm happy that you're here to help me. But I've heard that humans need a lot of rest. Please come back again after dawn.
scripts.translation: 嗯......你願意幫忙，我很高興。不過我聽說人類需要充分休息，請天亮後再來。

scripts.text: Thank you for your help. Then can I ask you to exterminate ^0000CD15 Boiling Piranha and 15 Boiling Marc^000000?
scripts.translation: 謝謝你願意幫忙。能請你消滅15只沸騰食人魚和15只沸騰馬克嗎？ ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: I'd like to take a break today..
I see. I've heard that humans should rest often.
scripts.translation: 我明白。聽說人類需要經常休息。

scripts.text: Then I'll let you handle it.
Did you forgot about it? then please exterminate ^0000CD15 Boiling Piranha and 15 Boiling Marc^000000.
scripts.translation: 忘了嗎？那就請去消滅15只沸騰食人魚和15只沸騰馬克。 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: Perfect. Thank you very much. I'd be more grateful if you could come back after dawn.
scripts.translation: 太好了，非常感謝。要是天亮後還能再來，我會更感激。

scripts.text: ^006600This is the place when you want to forget everything and immerse yourself into nature. However, if things are too difficult. Please come to us for assistance.^000000
scripts.translation: 泉想忘卻煩惱、融入自然時，就來這裡吧。若遇到難題，請來找我們幫忙。 ^006600^000000

scripts.translation: 特別訪客可以進入所有區域，所以我不能阻止你。不過在倉庫裡參觀時，請不要碰任何東西。

scripts.text: How did you come in here?
You don't even have a key with you.
I don't want to cause trouble, I'll go back.
Maybe you just got in accidentally.
scripts.translation: 你可能是不小心闖進來的。

scripts.translation: 你是來找宅邸藍圖的嗎？願意等的話

scripts.text: I'll bring it to you, if you can wait.
I remember the saying, that human lacks patience.
scripts.translation: 有句俗話說，人類都沒什麼耐心。

scripts.text: This is the second warehouse of the Varmundt Mansion.
scripts.translation: 這裡是瓦爾蒙特宅邸的第二倉庫。

scripts.text: Oh, is there no concept of warehouse for humans outside? The warehouse is where you store things that you don't use.
scripts.translation: 怎麼，外面的人類沒有倉庫的概念嗎？倉庫就是存放暫時不用的東西的地方。

scripts.text: I came here to get the mansion's blueprint and the ingredients for the restaurant. Did you come here in person because you don't trust me? If that's the case, please don't worry.
scripts.translation: 我來這裡取宅邸藍圖和餐廳食材。你是因為不放心，才親自來的嗎？如果是這樣，請不用擔心。

scripts.text: I've been in charge of the warehouse for a very long time, I can quickly old or very small items that have been stored.
scripts.translation: 我管理倉庫很久了，不管是舊物還是很小的東西，都能很快找到。

scripts.text: Needless to say, I also remember where the blueprint is.
scripts.translation: 當然，我也記得藍圖放在哪裡。

scripts.text: I'm an automatic doll. We don't lose memories.
scripts.translation: 我是自動人偶，不會忘記。

scripts.text: I'm not looking for a blueprint.
Is that so? I misunderstood the situation.
I didn't think there would be any humans visiting the warehouse. Usually the humans that come all the way here were usually thieves.
scripts.translation: 。我沒想到會有人類來倉庫。通常特地跑來這裡的人類都是小偷。

scripts.text: That doesn't mean that you are a thief. Becayse you wouldn't have qualified as a guest. The Varmundt Mansion does not invite everyone as a guest.
scripts.translation: 不過這不代表你是小偷，因為你已經獲准成為客人了。瓦爾蒙特宅邸不會隨便邀請人來做客。

scripts.text: Even if you have that intention, it won't be easy to find what you want here anyway.
scripts.translation: 就算你另有企圖，在這裡也不容易找到想要的東西。

scripts.text: Of course, it's an old warehouse of Varmundt.
scripts.translation: 當然，這裡是瓦爾蒙特的舊倉

scripts.text: It's this big now because there is not enough space to keep all items from all over the continent, that's why we constantly expanded and renovated it.
scripts.translation: 庫。由於要存放來自大陸各地的物品，空間逐漸不夠，我們才不斷擴建翻修，變成現在這麼大。
